name: Cruithín na Cuan
text: Cruithín na Cuan names a kind of city in Irish story. It stands in the wondrous land of Emain Ablach, the island realm linked with the sea god Manannán mac Lir. The place belongs to the overseas Otherworld rather than to any real map of Ireland. Readers should follow the Emain Ablach entry for that island and its marvels.

attributes.attribute: a kind of city in the Otherworld island Emain Ablach

okr.objective: Places Cruithín na Cuan in the Otherworld island of Emain Ablach.
key_results: Describes the place as a kind of city.
